content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The FAD's finding of no discrimination or retaliation cannot be traced to documented evidence, since Complainant was only asked to verify claims 1-3 and 5-9, no analysis linking evidence to the conclusion is described, and the named witnesses were never interviewed."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most statements are attributed with ROI page cites (Complainant ROI 60-80, Supervisor ROI 146-162, Associate Chief ROI 295-299, Chief ROI 309-312, HR Specialist ROI 316-326), but the Supervisor's responses are not summarized, and the basis for the FAD's findings and for the claim that Complainant was praised earlier is not identified."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Dated events for the nine claims, the March 13 complaint, May 8 acceptance, and March 18 accommodation withdrawal are laid out, but the date and content of the Supervisor conversation before the warning letter, the timing of Complainant's protected activity, and the FAD date are not recorded."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not show who decided the FAD, what criteria were applied, or whether Complainant's unexplored allegations and the accommodation refusal were weighed, and the Investigator gave no reason for skipping the six listed witnesses."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"With no witness affidavits, no questioning of Complainant on eight claims, no summary of the Supervisor's responses, and no decision rationale, an independent reviewer could not assess whether the FAD is supported by the record."}}}
